title: Load and Unload
prompt: The Quartermaster packs and unpacks while you watch. Call the satchel's contents after every move.

steps.note: append always adds to the END. Never the front, never the middle.
Four crates now. The satchel grew; nothing was replaced.
pop takes from the END too — the last one in is the first one out. Water is gone.

config.success: On at the back, off at the back. That is the whole discipline of a satchel.
